morbi.headline: Morbi faces operational stress with unit shutdowns, high inventory, and rising fuel costs
what_changed: Morbi ceramic production cycle slowed down, resulting in full warehouses of unsold stock and 15% of units shutting down
Attempts to mitigate or control elevated propane gas prices have failed, increasing operational challenges
Proposed ceramic testing laboratory for Bikaner's 200 clay mines is being relocated to Jaipur due to building possession delays
stress_signals: 15% of ceramic manufacturing units have shut down due to high inventory and production slowdowns [64076d83f199]
Rising propane gas prices remain uncontrolled, straining operational costs for cluster units [64076d83f199]
what_to_watch: Inventory liquidation trends and warehouse stock levels across ceramic manufacturing accounts
Propane gas price movements and impact on unit-level operating margins and debt serviceability
Operational continuity and capacity utilization metrics to identify further potential unit closures

surat.headline: Surat faces severe textile disruptions from yarn price shocks and labor strikes, despite diamond recovery.
what_changed: Textile and weaving sub-segments face severe margin compression due to a reported 66% yarn price hike and stricter 15-day payment terms.
Widespread labor unrest, 'Gaon Chalo' protests, and early worker exodus are disrupting textile operations ahead of Diwali.
Diamond sub-segment shows operational recovery, shortening Diwali vacations due to improved demand.
stress_signals: 66% hike in yarn prices creates shutdown risks for weaving units, forcing two-day weekly operational holidays [b62552cc0c7d, 0c72a246c955].
Escalating labor strikes, wage disputes, and worker exodus to UP/Bihar threaten cluster capacity [d6a4b0e6a74b, 6b7974c7f88e, 73dfcce5d3f4, a9383cbae2cf].
Pre-Diwali recessionary pressures and trade fraud cases (including a ₹15.57 crore scam) heighten liquidity and payment risks [28ff6df05700, cf2229091691, 2718cba9f837].
Kadodara Crossroads traffic gridlock is causing localized supply chain and freight delays [a6a3c64ac321].
improvement_signals: Diamond industry reports operational resurgence, shortening Diwali vacations to meet demand and considering wage cut rollbacks [2b47ff4fa01a, ff0f473e0921].
MANTRA-trained entrepreneurs built ₹120 crore in textile businesses, and local units successfully tested technical textiles for defense [7dc3005e0b28, 5a6c6ad01d9d].
what_to_watch: Weaving and processing accounts' working capital utilization amid mandatory 15-day yarn payment rules.
Capacity utilization and headcount drops in textile units due to early Diwali migrant worker exodus.
Compliance tracking with the newly mandated Textile Statistical Returns System (TSRS) portal.
